key.name: items
key.description: JSON array describing the menu. Entries: {"type":"app","id":"org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop","admin":true}, {"type":"separator"} and {"type":"submenu","title":"Name","children":[...]}. A submenu can only contain apps and separators. Edited through the extension preferences.

key.name: launch-mode
key.description: "new-window" opens a new window of the app when possible; "focus-or-launch" focuses the app if it is already running and starts it otherwise.

key.name: show-settings-item
key.description: Append an entry that opens the extension preferences. It is always shown while the menu is empty.

key.name: admin-mode
key.description: Allow apps marked in the menu editor to be run as administrator by holding Ctrl while choosing them. Authentication is always requested through polkit or sudo.
